kpis: Lost >100% of margin on one trade
findings: Most top lead traders are short-term traders, not bots: median hold 6 hours, 37 of 85 hold under 4 hours (scalpers).
They trade both directions: about 45% of positions are shorts. Our original bot was long-only — the new app lets any strategy go short or both.

Very high win rates (median 88%) with small average wins come from taking profit early and sitting through losers. 29 of 85 had a single trade lose more than 100% of its margin — the classic sign of averaging down without a stop. The app keeps a hard exchange stop on every trade, including DCA baskets.

Leverage drives the leaderboard: the 2,500%+ ROI traders run 15-20x and carry 38-55% max drawdowns. The low-drawdown group (MDD under 25%, 57 traders) are mostly fast scalpers at ~10x with worst trades around -23%.
40% of them trade TradFi perpetuals (gold XAU, memory stocks SNDK/SKHYNIX/MU, oil, SOXL) next to BTC/ETH and the hot coin of the moment (ZEC, HYPE). You can add these symbols on the Coins tab.

What we took from them: partial take-profit + breakeven (Squeeze, Pullback strategies), hot-coin momentum chase, shorts, and DCA safety orders — each with hard stops. What we avoided: no-stop averaging down.

Research also used: Concretum Group's Donchian-ensemble trend model (Sharpe >1.5 on top-20 coins), Freqtrade/NostalgiaForInfinity protections (cooldowns, max-drawdown guard), 3Commas DCA safety-order and multi-take-profit mechanics.
Caveat: the leaderboard shows survivors of the last 90-180 days; many high-ROI accounts disappear after one bad month.
